name: compare
title: Compare
description: A side-by-side slider between the build you are looking at and a baseline (staging, production, the last published Storybook). Both panes are embedded through the host proxy, so both are logged in, interactive and mirrored.

baselineUrl.title: Baseline URL
baselineUrl.description: The default right-hand side when only one URL is given — e.g. your staging or production origin. Leave empty to always pass both URLs explicitly.

autoPath.title: Keep the path
autoPath.description: Take the path and query of the URL under review and apply them to the baseline origin. Off: the baseline URL is opened exactly as written.
